description.en: Separate broad sterile fronds and bead-like fertile fronds arise along a creeping rhizome.
description.zh: 宽营养叶与串珠状育性叶分别沿匍匐根茎长出。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Onoclea sensibilis; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Onoclea sensibilis 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Two strongly different frond architectures and spaced rhizome emergence distinguish it from the existing uniform fern rosette.
distinctness.zh: 两类明显不同叶形及沿根茎分散出叶区别于现有均一蕨莲座。

modeling_brief.en: Use broad lobed foliage beside narrow branched bead fronds, joined by one rhizome; do not count the two frond forms separately.
modeling_brief.zh: 把宽裂营养叶与窄分枝珠状育性叶连在同一根茎，不分别计两类叶形。

uncertainty: Fossil and modern comparison supports gross form; colour and seasonal state are artistic choices.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Paleobotany and Palynology of the Munce's Hill fossil locality
sources.supports: Paleocene Onoclea fertile and sterile fronds documented together; later usage of Joffrea speirsiae for the Joffrea concept.

sources.title: Onoclea sensibilis taxon profile
sources.supports: Living analogue morphology: creeping rhizome and strongly dimorphic beaded fertile fronds.
